answer: A sybil farm must acquire and lock one opal bond per fake identity plus matching peer attestations, costs that scale linearly while rewards stay capped. Agents bond a scarce, verifiable opal token to register, staked against a trellis of peer-vouched identity links that grow only through sustained honest work. Like a zephyr scattering loose seed, unstaked clones drift away unranked, since only bonded participants earn epochs and reputation. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
